copper-coast-1.name: Moonta Mines State Heritage Area
copper-coast-1.bio: Cornish copper-mining site at Moonta with the Hughes Enginehouse, a museum and a tourist railway.
copper-coast-1.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=museum node 2158528226 (Moonta Mines Model School Museum, the heritage area's visitor hub); Commons geotag median within 100 m
notes: Area is open to walk; the museum (about $10 adult) and tourist railway ($12 adult) are National Trust attractions inside it, not priced on the spot.
copper-coast-1.ticket_note: No single official page for the heritage area; National Trust museum/railway pages cover only parts of it.

copper-coast-4.name: Wallaroo Heritage and Nautical Museum

yorke-peninsula-2.name: Troubridge Island

destination.name: Copper Coast
destination.tagline: Cornish copper towns and jetty beaches on the northern Yorke Peninsula coast.
destination.description: The Copper Coast is the northern Yorke Peninsula around Kadina, Wallaroo and Moonta, where Cornish miners worked copper from the 1860s. Moonta Mines is a state heritage area with a museum, tourist railway and walking trails, and Kadina's Farm Shed Museum holds the stump-jump plough. Wallaroo has a heritage and nautical museum and North Beach, while Moonta Bay and Port Hughes add jetties and swimming beaches. A sealed rail trail links Kadina, Wallaroo and Moonta.
whyVisit: Swim and fish off jetty beaches
Cycle the sealed coastal rail trail

goodToKnow.title: Check museum hours
goodToKnow.detail: Wallaroo's museum is shut most Mondays and Moonta's has set afternoon hours, so check times before you drive.

goodToKnow.title: Cycle in sections
goodToKnow.detail: The sealed 25 km rail trail runs Kadina to Moonta via Wallaroo, so ride one stretch and drive back.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} are the warm months for beach days and jetty swims at Moonta Bay and Wallaroo.

notes: Pin: OSM place=town node 'Kadina town' (33119329); nearest spot Farm Shed Museum 1.2 km. Span cut from 60 to 45: all spots are within 20 km, 75% of 45 = 34 km.
Category set to beach (draft said city) because the destination is a coast of several towns, not one town.
Order kept as drafted. Moonta Mines/Wheal Hughes need a review of Wheal Hughes access (see its notes).

destination.name: Yorke Peninsula
destination.tagline: Long jetties, red clay cliffs and lighthouses around a farming peninsula west of Adelaide.
destination.description: Yorke Peninsula is a farming peninsula between Gulf St Vincent and Spencer Gulf, ringed by small coastal towns with long jetties. Ardrossan sits on top of red clay cliffs, Edithburgh has a tidal swimming pool and Wool Bay a jetty and lime kilns, and Port Victoria keeps a maritime museum. Corny Point Lighthouse looks over the far southwest, and an 1855 lighthouse stands on Troubridge Island offshore from Edithburgh.
whyVisit: Swim in tidal pools and bays

goodToKnow.title: Catch the cliffs at sunrise
goodToKnow.detail: Walk out on Ardrossan's jetty at sunrise to see the red clay cliffs lit up by the morning light.

goodToKnow.title: Troubridge Island needs a permit
goodToKnow.detail: The island is boat-only and needs a permit from the operator at Edithburgh, so arrange it well ahead.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} are mild enough for jetty walks and long coastal drives.
